categories.main_business_segments: Eoptolink Technology Inc., Ltd primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of optical communication modules. Its product portfolio includes high-speed optical modules such as 100G, 200G, 400G, 800G, and 1.6T modules, serving applications in AI/machine learning clusters, cloud data centers, data communications, 5G wireless networks, telecom transmission, and fixed network access. The company also develops coherent optical modules and silicon photonics solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including VCSEL/EML, silicon photonics, thin-film lithium niobate, coherent optical communication, and LPO (Linear Polarization Optical) technology. It has capabilities in high-speed optical device chip packaging and optical device packaging. Production is order-based, managed via ERP systems to optimize material usage and control costs, with a focus on automation and lean manufacturing to improve efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global mainstream internet companies and communication equipment manufacturers. The company serves domestic and international markets, focusing on data centers, telecom operators, and internet service providers. Its products are critical for AI clusters, cloud computing, 5G front-haul, mid-haul, backhaul networks, metropolitan area networks, backbone networks, and core network transmission.
categories.geographic_coverage: Eoptolink operates primarily in China with significant overseas presence through subsidiaries in Hong Kong, the United States, Singapore, and Thailand. Its products are sold globally, with approximately 78.7% of revenue generated from international markets. The company maintains manufacturing facilities in China and Thailand, with ongoing expansion projects to increase production capacity.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the optical communication supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing and assembly of optical modules. It procures upstream components such as optical chips, integrated circuits, and structural parts from suppliers, and sells finished optical modules downstream to equipment manufacturers and internet companies. It is pursuing vertical integration to cover chip manufacturing, chip packaging, device packaging, and module manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing high-speed optical modules (up to 1.6T), silicon photonics, coherent optical modules, and LPO technology. The company invests heavily in R&D, with a 4.66% revenue allocation in 2024, focusing on low-power, long-distance, and data center interconnect modules. It emphasizes talent acquisition, collaboration with industry and academia, and continuous innovation to maintain technological leadership and expand market share.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of optical communication modules to communication equipment manufacturers, internet companies, and distributors. The company employs a direct sales model domestically and a combination of direct and buyout distributor sales internationally. Revenue recognition follows shipment and acceptance criteria, with FOB, FCA, DDP, and DAP terms for exports.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Eoptolink is positioned as a leading domestic optical module supplier with capabilities in mass production of 100G to 1.6T modules. It competes with global and domestic optical communication component manufacturers by leveraging advanced packaging technologies and diversified product lines. The company has established strong partnerships with major global internet and telecom equipment vendors, enhancing its competitive standing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 8.65 billion, a 179.15% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 2.84 billion, up 312.26%. Total assets nearly doubled to RMB 12.27 billion, with equity increasing by 52.36%. The company shows strong growth momentum driven by expanding market demand and capacity enhancements, including a new factory phase in Thailand.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Eoptolink emphasizes high-performance, high-speed optical modules with diverse packaging and interface options tailored for AI, cloud data centers, and telecom networks. Its competitive advantages include proprietary chip packaging technology, flexible production lines, and a broad product portfolio covering multiple transmission standards and distances. The company focuses on innovation, low power consumption, and cost efficiency to meet evolving customer needs and maintain market leadership.
